job.title: Maintenance Worker
job.description:
Disclaimer: SLB completed the acquisition of ChampionX on July 16, 2025. If selected for this position, your employment will begin with ChampionX and will transition to SLB as part of the planned integration.

We are looking for a Maintenance Worker located in West Valley City, UT. This is your opportunity to join a global technology company, driving energy innovation for a balanced planet.

What’s in it For You:

  • Join a growing company offering competitive pay
  • Comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with company matching and more
  • Tackle some of the world’s most meaningful challenges including, helping customers achieve clean water, safe food, abundant energy, and healthy environments
  • The ability to shape your career with a company that is passionate about growth
  • Be part of a culture that values its employees and puts safety first
  • Grow your income as you drive growth
  • Opportunity for a long term, advanced career path
  • Access to Employee Resource Groups (ERG’s). These employee-led groups allow employees to come together to explore common interests and foster a diverse and inclusive workplace
  • Access to best-in-class resources, tools, and technology

What You Will Do:

  • Support and engage in our vision of improving lives 
  • Live and be an example of Quartzdyne’s core values: Respect, Grit, Transparency, Honesty, Humility and Accountability 
  • Be a disciple and leader of continuous improvement

Position Details:

  • Performs a wide range of mechanical and electrical maintenance tasks
  • Uses hand and power tools to accomplish these tasks
  • Light repair to machines and facility
  • Light fabrication of metal work and wood work
  • Painting of production equipment and facility
  • Moves production equipment in line changes
  • Changes lubrication and heat transfer fluids in production equipment
  • Maintains fans, compressors, air dryers, and chillers
  • Replaces lighting and ballasts as needed
  • Assists in companywide recycling program of materials and chemicals
  • Drives company vehicle to pick and parts and materials
  • Other maintenance related duties as assigned

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma/GED required
  • 2 years experience in general maintenance work
  • Skills using Microsoft Word, PowerPoint and Excel
  • Must be able to drive the company vehicle
  • Valid driver’s license required
  • Immigration sponsorship not offered for this role

Physical Demands:

  • Normal working conditions absent extreme factors 
  • Must be able to see well enough to read reports, send emails, etc.
  • Must be able to hear and speak well enough to communicate with customers and fellow employees 
  • Must be able to lift up to 100lbs periodically
  • Role is deemed safety-sensitive and may be subject to employer or customer drug testing

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Skills in identifying and resolving employee, customer and vendor problems
  • Ability to communicate effectively and professionally with coworkers, customers and vendors both verbally and in writing
  • Ability to work effectively independently and as part of a team
  • Ability to follow oral and written instructions
  • Ability to organize daily activities of self and others
  • Strong desire to learn and be a problem solver
  • Ethical behavior required at all times

Position Compensation and Benefits:

  • Competitive base salaries
  • Medical
  • Dental
  • Vision
  • Employer paid STD and LTD
  • 1X your annual salary of employer paid life insurance
  • 15 days of paid vacation to start
  • 7 days of paid personal leave
  • 12 paid holidays
  • HSA Funding
  • Generous profit sharing
  • 401(k) match up to 6%

About Us

ChampionX is now part of SLB, a global technology company driving energy innovation for a balanced planet. As innovators, that’s been our mission for nearly a century.

We are a technology company that unlocks access to energy for the benefit of all. Today, we face a global imperative to create a future with more energy, but less carbon. Our diverse, innovative change makers are focused on going further in innovation and inventing the new energy technologies we need to get there.

For more news and information, visit SLB.com

Follow us on Facebook: @WeAreSLBGlobal, LinkedIn: SLBGlobal, or Instagram: @SLBGlobal

About Quartzdyne

Quartzdyne, an SLB Company, designs and manufactures precision pressure and temperature transducers for the oil and gas industry. Our proprietary offerings have become the industry standard, elevating how critical data is used to assess the performance of a reservoir and increase oil production. Our sensors are world-renowned for providing intensely accurate and high-resolution data under the most extreme conditions. At Quartzdyne, we live by our core values of Respect, Grit, Honesty, Transparency, Humility and Accountability. Quartzdyne is located along the beautiful Wasatch mountain range in Utah.

job.title: Account Manager
job.description:
Disclaimer: SLB completed the acquisition of ChampionX on July 16, 2025. If selected for this position, your employment will begin with ChampionX and will transition to SLB as part of the planned integration.

We are looking for an Account Manager located in Bonnyville, AB, area working a regular 5 day – 40 hour work week.  The Account Manager will be primarily responsible for servicing existing programs as well as developing and applying chemical solutions for remediation of customer challenges within targeted accounts in the sales area.

You will be a self starter that has excellent time management skills and a desire to meet customer demands. Strong communication skills are a requirement for this role. In addition, you will be responsible for building long-term relationships throughout your customer base by understanding their key business drivers, executing system assurance programs, and deploying new technologies.

If you have experience as an oilfield operator, as an engineer/engineering technologist or have a proven track record of success in technical sales, we invite you to apply. This is your opportunity to join a large growing company offering a competitive base salary, bonus structure and benefits.

What’s in it For You:

  • Flexible, independent work environment where you will manage a monthly schedule

  • Access to best-in-class resources, tools, and technology

  • Grow your income as you drive growth

  • Thrive in a company that values a culture of safety to include top-notch safety training and personal protection equipment

  • Comprehensive benefits package that includes extended health benefits, a company-paid pension plan, and more!

What You Will Do:

  • Work closely with current and new customers within an assigned territory/customer base.  Understand customer business needs and recommend continuous improvement and innovation plans that will drive customer loyalty.

  • Develop strong relationships with key stakeholders in current and new customer organizations, including plant or facility executives.

  • Generate and execute sales plans in assigned customer base and new customer accounts to meet defined territory profit increase goals.

  • Provide technical support to customers; identifying and resolving customer issues, escalating as required.

  • Engage in problem solving by performing system analysis, interpreting data and providing written recommendations to ensure customer operations are performing at optimal levels.

  • Possible travel within assigned sales territory

Position Details:

  • Candidate must reside within the Lakeland/Bonnyville region.

  • No immigration sponsorship offered.

  • This is a safety sensitive position, and the successful candidate will be required to complete drug and alcohol testing.

  • Must have a valid Driver’s License and acceptable Motor Vehicle Record

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 3 -5 years of technical sales, operating/engineering experience is preferred but not required.

  • High computer application literacy (including Microsoft Office Suite, and ability to learn internal business systems)

  • Prior experience that demonstrates a strong work ethic and ability to multitask

Physical Demands:

  • Must have the ability to Lift/Push/Pull/Carry up to 55 pounds chest high.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in the oil and gas industry preferred

  • Previous Petrochemical experience

  • Water treatment or specialty chemical industry experience

  • Working knowledge of water treatment systems

  • History of working in a field that required autonomy and self-motivation

  • Prior experience that required excellent communication skills

  • Prior experience that required excellent organizational skills

  • Account leadership experience that includes calling on multilevel plant or facilities management to accomplish company goals

job.title: Supervisor - Drive Shop VSD Repair
job.description:
Disclaimer: SLB completed the acquisition of ChampionX on July 16, 2025. If selected for this position, your employment will begin with ChampionX and will transition to SLB as part of the planned integration.

We are looking for a Variable Speed Drive Supervisor located in Odessa, TX. This is your opportunity to join a global technology company, driving energy innovation for a balanced planet.

What’s In It For You:

  • Flexible, independent work environment where you will manage a monthly schedule
  • Access to best-in-class resources, tools, and technology
  • Grow your income as you drive growth
  • Thrive in a company that values a culture of safety to include top-notch safety training and personal protection equipment
  • Comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with company matching and more!

What You Will Do:

  • Supervise daily activities of VSD technicians, including assembly, programming, testing, troubleshooting, and maintenance
  • Ensure safe and efficient workflow aligned with manufacturing and ESP operational goals
  • Coordinate with Engineering, Applications, Quality, and Supply Chain to resolve product issues and implement process improvements
  • Review and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, single-line diagrams, and PLC/VFD documentation to support technical troubleshooting
  • Lead root-cause analysis for equipment failures, electrical issues, and production defects
  • Maintain ERP-driven workflows for production orders, inventory accuracy, BOM validation, and work order completion
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives aimed at reducing downtime, improving quality, and enhancing operational throughput
  • Train and develop VSD personnel in product knowledge, safe work practices, and troubleshooting methods
  • Ensure compliance with company safety policies and electrical standards

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5 years of experience working with VSDs/VFDs in manufacturing, electrical assembly, artificial lift, or industrial equipment settings
  • Experience in the ESP industry (service, engineering, repair, or manufacturing).
  • Proficiency with ERP systems – including Oracle, SAP, or similar – for work order management, parts consumption, and production tracking
  • Ability to read and interpret wiring diagrams, ladder logic, I/O schematics, and electrical drawings
  • Strong troubleshooting capabilities for VSDs, electrical panels, control circuits, and instrumentation
  • Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with Applications Engineering, Product Engineering, Quality, and Operations
  • Strong leadership skills with experience supervising teams or leading technical workflows
  • Excellent communication, organizational, and documentation skills
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, Outlook, Word PowerPoint)
  • Immigration sponsorship not offered for this role

Physical Demands:

  • Ability to stand, bend, lift, and move throughout the manufacturing floor
  • Comfortable working around energized electrical equipment under proper safe-work practices
  • May require overtime or off-shift support based on production needs

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Industrial Technology, or related field
  • Experience with ESP surface equipment, switchboards, and artificial lift control systems
  • Familiarity with PLC programming concepts or HMI interfaces Background in continuous improvement, Lean, or root-cause analysis methodologies

job.title: RD&E Group Leader
job.description:
Disclaimer: SLB completed the acquisition of ChampionX on July 16, 2025. If selected for this position, your employment will begin with ChampionX and will transition to SLB as part of the planned integration.

We are searching for an RD&E Group Leader for our Diagnostic Solutions team located in Sugar Land, Texas.  As a Group Leader, you will align resources and prioritize projects amongst your team to ensure targets are met. You will act as a liaison with internal and external customers to define scopes of work and communicate project updates. The ideal candidate is highly versatile, communicates effectively, thrives in a collaborative environment, and has a strong track record of leading project teams to deliver technical solutions to complex problems. 

What's in it For You:

  • A flexible, independent work environment where you will manage a monthly schedule

  • Access to best-in-class resources, tools and technology

  • Thrive in a company that values a culture of safety to include top-notch safety training and personal protection equipment

  • Comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, a company-paid pension plan, tuition reimbursement and more!

What You Will Do:

In this role, as RD&E Group Leader for the Diagnostic Solutions team, your primary responsibility is assisting and enabling your teams to provide materials compatibility and analytical support for our customers and researchers. This is a leadership position, and the successful candidate will be responsible for the safety, quality, productivity and talent development of their teams.

Main responsibilities:

  • Provide leadership and technical expertise to the Materials Compatibility team and the Waters, Deposits, and Hydrocarbons Analytical team

  • Lead the team's technical effort under the guidance of the senior leadership, utilizing experience in fundamental science, oil field problem solving, chemical manufacturing/scale-up support, and project/people management

  • Ensure each associate performs duties in a safe and efficient manner, maintains quality standards, and continues to grow and develop expertise

  • Provide materials compatibility and analytical support for internal stakeholders and the company’s customers

  • Apply performance management guidelines for setting performance goals, evaluating and promoting career growth and development, conducting performance appraisals, and recommending salary and performance adjustments.

  • Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Technology teams to scope projects and identify needs/gaps to feed future projects

  • Work closely with team members to help ensure effective and efficient operations

  • Engage with key stakeholders to forecast sample and project demand to enable effective resource allocation to meet business timelines

  • Identify opportunities for third-party testing to reduce sample backlogs and expand testing capabilities as needed

  • Manage several projects at once while working within a fast-paced environment

  • Hire and train new team members as needed

Position Details: This position is located in Sugar Land, Texas.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Degree in analytical chemistry, materials science, polymer science or related scientific/technical discipline (required, and relevant experience including technology strategy development & implementation, leading & developing teams, and driving innovation. Education and experience should fall in one of the following levels:

    • Bachelors degree and 7 years experience; OR

    • Masters degree and 4 years experience; OR

    • PhD and 2 years experience

  • Five or more years of relevant experiences in management, technology development and innovation areas.

  • Requires track record of successful technology development and leveraging of external technology.

  • Ability to motivate individuals to operate as a part of a high-functioning team

  • Ability to travel up to 20%

Preferred Qualifications:

  • For the Materials Compatibility team, experience with at least one of the following techniques is highly desired: Tensile, Hardness, measurement of corrosion rates, high pressure (2000 psi), high temperature (500 °F) immersion testing, failure analysis, electrochemistry (critical pitting temperature and anodic cyclic polarization).

  • For the Waters, Deposits, and Hydrocarbons Analytical team, experience with common analytical techniques such as ICP, IC, XRF, XRD, SEM, and GC is highly desired.

  • Excellent time management skills

  • Excellent written, oral, and visual communication skills to communicate effectively with all levels of the organization, both within and outside the business

  • Previous supervisory experience is preferred

  • Experience with Specialty Chemicals in the Oil & Gas industry is preferred

job.title: Shop Mechanic
job.description:
Disclaimer: SLB completed the acquisition of ChampionX on July 16, 2025. If selected for this position, your employment will begin with ChampionX and will transition to SLB as part of the planned integration.

We are looking for a Shop Mechanic located in Odessa, TX, this role is responsible for installs, maintains, and repairs hydraulic jet pumps, high-pressure fluid systems. This is your opportunity to join a global technology company, driving energy innovation for a balanced planet.

What’s In It For You:

  • The ability to make an impact and shape your career with a company that is passionate about growth

  • The support of an organization that believes it is vital to include and engage diverse people, perspectives, and ideas to achieve our best

  • Thrive in a company that values sustainability, drives a safety-focused culture and empowers its employees through continuous improvement

  • Comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, 401(k) company matching, employee stock purchase option and more!

What You Will Do:

  • Responsible for maintenance and repair of hydraulic systems

  • Diagnose faults in pumps, valves, motors, and hydraulic lines; replace or repair defective components

  • Test repaired or newly installed systems to ensure optimal pressure, flow, and efficiency 

  • Tear down units, disassemble pumps for inspection

  • Minor welds on bracing for piping, etc.

  • Reassemble units, prep for test

  • Knows and complies with all safety policies and procedures.

  • Contributes to the departments continuous improvement culture.

  • Others duties as required.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High school diploma, GED, or equivalent education and/or experience

  • 2 years of similar work experience in a technical field/mechanic position

  • Welding experience

  • Experience using hand tools

  • Strong mechanical skills, preferred expertise with jet pumps

  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, able to identify and resolve problems.

  • Good oral and written communication skills, able to express thoughts clearly, both orally and in writing, using good grammar. 

  • Good computer skills, including Microsoft Office suite

Physical Demands:

  • The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.  Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • The role is deemed safety-sensitive and may be subject to employer or customer drug testing.

  • The employee is regularly required to stand for the entire work day.

  • The employee regularly lifts and carries 20 lbs regularly, and 50 lbs occasionally.

  • Work is primarily executed on the production floor, with varying temperatures and high levels of noise; personal safety equipment such as glasses and protective shoes may be required.

  • Exposure to shop elements, such as, dust, petroleum-based products, and other chemicals.

  • Work may require visits to customer field locations in a variety of weather and temperature conditions.

  • May include working nights, weekends, and/or extended hours as the business need arises.

  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

  • The employee is regularly required to talk or hear.

  • The employee is frequently required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel and reach with hands and arms.

  • Employee must be able to regularly bend, stoop, crawl, lay down, twist and push.

  • Employee is required to wear appropriate personal protective equipment including but not limited to shoes/boots, hard hats, or respirators.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Oil and gas industry experience, preferred jet pumps

  • Good mechanical skills, able to perform mechanical field maintenance work to ensure optimal availability and reliability of artificial lift equipment.

  • Reliable and dependability, follows instructions, responds to management direction; Takes responsibility for own actions; Commits to long hours of work when necessary to reach goals.

  • Teamwork/Relationships, able to work with others willingly and in a spirit of cooperation and teamwork. Demonstrates a commitment to the entire organization and is supportive of all initiatives to help grow the team.

Drive culture of safety; Report safety observations / incidents

  • Excellent written and verbal communications skills

Physical Demands:

  • Must have the ability to Lift/Carry up to 50 pounds chest high, climb stairs or ladders, and agile enough to squat and bend over (Agility Tests 1, 2a, 2b).

job.title: Principal Chemist
job.description:
Disclaimer: SLB completed the acquisition of ChampionX on July 16, 2025. If selected for this position, your employment will begin with ChampionX and will transition to SLB as part of the planned integration.

We are seeking a Principal Chemist to join our Production Maximization team in Sugar Land, Texas. In this role, you will provide technical leadership for a global portfolio of production chemistry technologies designed to maximize oil and gas production. You will lead the development and advancement of chemistry solutions for phase separation, water clarification, emulsion resolution, and flow improvement—helping customers improve asset performance, production efficiency, and overall operational reliability.

The ideal candidate brings the ability to turn complex technical challenges into practical, customer-focused solutions. You are an effective communicator, a collaborative partner, and a scientist who thrives in a dynamic, hands-on environment.

If you are passionate about translating chemistry into field-ready production solutions, we encourage you to apply. This is an opportunity to join a growing organization where you can lead innovation, influence product strategy, and deliver measurable value to customers across the energy industry.

What’s in it For You:

  • Make an impact and shape your career with a company committed to growth and innovation.

  • Join an organization that values diverse perspectives, inclusive collaboration, and the power of great teams.

  • Thrive in a company that prioritizes sustainability and fosters a strong safety-first culture.

  • Access a comprehensive benefits package starting on day one, including medical, dental, vision, a matching 401(k), and more.

What You Will Do:

  • Champion a strong safety culture by upholding company standards, promoting best practices, and identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.

  • Lead theoretical and applied research to solve complex production chemistry challenges related to phase separation, emulsion treatment, water clarification, and flow improvement.

  • Drive strategic technology and product development projects with global relevance and meaningful impact on the business.

  • Design and optimize innovative production chemistry formulations that address customer needs and improve field performance.

  • Develop and refine laboratory test methods, screening protocols, and application approaches to evaluate product performance and support successful technology deployment.

  • Interpret experimental and field data, generate actionable insights, and communicate findings through clear technical reports and presentations.

  • Advance continuous improvement across products, processes, and technical workflows to support responsible energy production and long-term business growth.

  • Collaborate across R&D, applications, manufacturing, supply chain, and commercial teams to move technologies from concept through field adoption.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Degree in Chemistry or a related technical field: Ph.D. or M.S. with 2 years of relevant experience, or B.S. with 4 years of relevant experience.

  • Experience in synthetic chemistry, surface science, or polymer or small-molecule development, supported by strong analytical and characterization capabilities.

  • Understanding structure-property-performance relationships and the ability to apply that knowledge to practical production chemistry challenges.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, including the ability to interpret incomplete data, make sound technical judgments, and drive decisions forward.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Degree in Chemistry or a related technical field: Ph.D. or M.S. with 3+ years of relevant experience, or B.S. with 5+ years of relevant experience.

  • Proven ability to engage with customers, identify technical needs, and translate those needs into differentiated production chemistry solutions.

  • Experience scaling products from laboratory development to pilot and full production, including close collaboration with manufacturing and operations teams.

  • Experience with Design of Experiments, data analytics, or statistical tools to accelerate formulation development and optimize performance is a plus.

  • Strong attention to detail, sound prioritization skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.

  • Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across technical, operational, customer, and leadership audiences.

Physical Demands:

  • Role is deemed safety-sensitive and may be subject to employer or customer drug testing

job.title: Senior Staff Scientist
job.description:
Disclaimer: SLB completed the acquisition of ChampionX on July 16, 2025. If selected for this position, employment will begin with ChampionX and will transition to SLB as part of the planned integration.

We are looking for Sr. Staff Scientist / Engineer will support strategic and transformational innovation projects for Production Chemical Technologies within the Technology Production Maximization team located in Sugar Land, Texas. This role is intended for a highly versatile technical expert who communicates effectively, thrives in a collaborative environment, and is comfortable operating autonomously in a hands-on research setting.

The role will advance applied scientific research and product development for Production Maximization product lines, with particular emphasis on emulsion breakers and water clarifiers. The successful candidate will leverage deep expertise in non-ionic surfactants, polymers, interfacial science, colloid and phase behavior, and structure-property relationships to design, formulate, and scale differentiated production chemistry solutions that address complex customer challenges and deliver high-impact innovation.

What You Will Do:

  • Adopt, maintain, and promote safety standards while identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.

  • Conduct applied scientific research to advance technical knowledge and solve complex production challenges related to water clarification and phase separation.

  • Apply fundamental knowledge of synthetic chemistry and interfacial science to formulate new products that meet customer needs.

  • Translate knowledge of non-ionic surfactants, polymers, and interfacial science into emulsion breaker and water clarifier formulations for Production Maximization product lines.

  • Design laboratory screening and performance evaluation strategies that connect formulation variables to oil-water separation, water clarity, emulsion stability, and field applicability.

  • Lead and execute strategic and transformational innovation projects with potential global reach and high business impact.

  • Conduct standardized testing protocols to evaluate product performance, analyze research data, and prepare detailed reports and presentations.

  • Own subject matter expertise for self-initiated research and serve as a technical resource, teacher, and mentor for others.

  • Lead the strategic direction of innovation while collaborating across RD&E teams and business functions.

  • Leverage external technology and collaborations with industry or academia during the innovation process.

  • Steward technical documentation and intellectual property, while monitoring the competitive landscape for disruptive technologies.

  • Work directly with business counterparts and customers to identify needs, translate those needs into technical solutions, and support new technology adoption.

  • Drive continuous improvement of the business to responsibly deliver energy and contribute to a safety-focused, inclusive, and sustainable culture.

Product Line and Science Focus

  • Use structure-property relationships, formulation science, and data-driven experimentation to translate molecular and formulation design into practical field performance.

  • Apply non-ionic surfactant chemistry, polymer science, and interfacial science to understand and manipulate adsorption, wetting, emulsion stability, phase separation, and solids/liquid interface behavior.

  • Develop and expand water clarifier technologies that improve water quality, accelerate separation, and address complex produced-water challenges through new chemistries, blends, and additive strategies.

  • Develop and advance differentiated emulsion breaker technologies for oil-water separation, dehydration, interface control, and field-relevant performance across Production Maximization applications.

Leadership, Culture, and Business Impact

  • Lead innovation with high business impact by applying strategic understanding of global markets, adjacencies, customer needs, and technical gaps to deliver breakthrough solutions.

  • Embody operating principles that reinforce safety, continuous improvement, accountability, collaboration, and inclusive leadership.

  • Build a broad sphere of influence as a safety leader, corporate citizen, mentor, and technical contributor.

  • Grow subject matter expertise through independent learning and by staying current with advances in science and technology.

  • Address personal development opportunities through self-awareness, feedback, mentoring, and engagement with senior leadership.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, or related technical field. PhD with 9-10+ years of relevant work experience; MS with 12+ years; or BS with 15+ years.

  • Experience with synthetic chemistry and advanced characterization techniques.

  • Strong background in interfacial science, non-ionic surfactant technologies, polymer chemistry, and formulation science relevant to emulsion breaker and water clarifier development.

  • Deep understanding of structure-property relationships and ability to apply them to oil-water separation, water clarification, emulsion stability, and other practical production chemistry challenges.

  • Proven capability developing innovative solutions, including product formulation and development.

  • Ability to work with business counterparts to support customers and enable new technology adoption.

  • Ability to analyze and interpret incomplete information and make sound technical recommendations.

  • Strong record of technical documentation, including reports, presentations, and intellectual property contributions.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Ability to connect and interact with customers to clearly identify needs and translate those needs into solutions.

  • Experience transitioning product development from laboratory scale to pilot and production scale.

  • Experience with formal Design of Experiments and/or data analytics.

  • Detail-oriented work style with excellent time management skills.

  • Excellent written, oral, and visual communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively at all levels of the organization and with external stakeholders.

  • Recognition as a technical expert, mentor, industry contributor, or trusted technical advisor.

Physical Demands:

  • This role is deemed safety-sensitive and may be subject to employer or customer drug testing.

The successful candidate will combine hands-on chemistry, quality assurance experience, pilot plant operational support and project management to ensure product quality, process reliability, and safe execution of scale-up activities.

  • Identify opportunities for process optimization and operational improvement

  • Adhere to all safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements, promoting a strong safety culture

  • Partner with corporate functions (RD&E, Supply Chain, Quality, and SHE teams) to investigate and resolve product quality and scale-up challenges

  • Experience with quality control processes and data management

  • Familiarity with quality management systems or software

  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Commitment to safety and operational excellence

  • Strong ownership of quality systems and data integrity

  • Proactive troubleshooting and continuous improvement mindset

  • Ability to bridge bench level chemistry with pilot plant and full-scale operations

  • Situational Adaptability

  • Work at times under limited supervision and lead projects with limited scope and complexity

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of SAP for quality data management

job.title: Field Service Technician - HPS
job.description:
Disclaimer: SLB completed the acquisition of ChampionX on July 16, 2025. If selected for this position, your employment will begin with ChampionX and will transition to SLB as part of the planned integration.

We are looking for a Field Service Technician to support the Horizontal Pump Systems (HPS) for our Artificial Lift business segment located in Roosevelt, UT. This is your opportunity to join a global technology company, driving energy innovation for a balanced planet.

What's In It For You:

  • Access to best-in-class resources, tools, and technology

  • Opportunity for a long term, advanced career path

  • A culture that values safety first, including training and personal protection

  • Comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with company matching and more!

What You Will Do:

  • A Horizontal Pump System Technician is responsible for the installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of horizontal pump systems (HPS) used in industrial, water treatment, oil & gas, and other process environments.

  • This role requires both mechanical and electrical skills to ensure pumps operate efficiently, safely, and in compliance with industry standards.

  • Ensure job deliverables are accurate and delivered on time.

  • Responsible for service delivery execution including installation of horizontal pumps, troubleshooting and perform service inspection.

  • Perform system testing, test pumps for proper flow, pressure and efficiency.

  • Participate in job risk analysis and continual improvement programs.

  • Develop customer contacts to promote company products and services.

  • Ensure company and regulatory standard compliance by implementing the CAT, self-assessments, and well-site inspections.

  • Participate in Service Quality Meetings with customers and improve performance using action plans.

  • Participate in HSE and Quality initiatives.

  • Wear PPE and observe HSE policies.

  • Maintain the required safety training.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Technical certification or high school diploma/GED

  • 2 years’ experience in field service work

  • 2-year experience with AC/DC motors, SCADA controls and communications systems and/or electrical work.

  • Must have a valid Drivers License

  • Can perform moderately complex pulls and installs independently

  • Strong customer relations skills including the ability to explain and train

  • Knowledge of wiring and cabling

  • Knowledge of proper use of hand tools

  • Strong mechanical and electrical aptitude

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability

  • Ability to follow prescribed company policies, procedures, and protocols for installation, service and equipment maintenance

Physical Demands:

  • Work a minimum of 8 hours per day, and available to work overtime as required to meet business needs.

  • Works both in the shop and on-site at customer locations.

  • May be required to drive for long periods of time

  • Operates in industrial or process environments, often outdoors or in confined spaces.

  • Requires ability to work under pressure, including emergency on-call situations

  • Role is deemed safety-sensitive and may be subject to employer or customer drug testing.

  • Exerting up to 50 pounds of force occasionally and/or up to 20 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects.

  • Climbing:  Ascending or descending ladders, stairs, scaffolding, ramps, poles, and the like, using feet and legs and/or hands and arms. Body agility is emphasized.

  • Balancing:  Maintaining body equilibrium to prevent falling when walking, standing, or crouching on narrow, slippery, or erratically moving surfaces.

  • Stooping:  Bending body downward and forward by bending spine at the waist. This factor is important if it occurs to a considerable degree and requires full use of the lower extremities and back muscles.

  • Kneeling:  Bending legs at knee to come to a rest on knees.

  • Crawling:  Moving about on hands and knees or hands and feet.

  • Reaching:  Extending hand(s) and arm(s) in any direction.

  • Walking:  Moving about on foot to accomplish tasks, particularly for long distances or moving from one work site to another.

  • Pushing:  Using upper extremities to press against something with steady force in order to thrust forward, downward, or outward.

  • Pulling:  Using upper extremities to exert force to draw, drag, haul, or tug objects in a sustained motion.

  • Lifting:  Raising objects from a lower to a higher position or moving objects horizontally from position to position.

  • Grasping:  Applying pressure to an object with the fingers and palm.

  • Feeling:  Perceiving attributes of objects, such as size, shape, temperature, or texture by touching with skin, particularly that of fingertips.

  • Talking:  Expressing or exchanging ideas by means of the spoken word.  Those activities in which they must convey detailed or important spoken instructions to customer or other workers accurately, loudly, or quickly.

  • Hearing:  Perceiving the nature of sounds at normal speaking levels with or without correction.  Ability to receive detailed information through oral communication, and to make the discriminations in sound.

  • Repetitive motion:  Substantial movement (motions) of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers to use a computer.

  • The employee is required to have close visual acuity to perform an activity such as: visual inspection involving small defects, small parts and/or operation of machines (including inspection), using measurement devices, and/or assembly or fabrication of parts at distances close to the eyes.

  • The employee is required to have visual acuity to operate motor vehicles.

  • The employee is required to have visual acuity to determine the accuracy, neatness, thoroughness of work assigned or to make general observations of facilities or structures.

  • Indoor and outdoor environmental conditions.  Activities occur indoors and outdoors.

  • Extreme heat.  Temperatures above 100 degrees for periods of more than one hour.  Consideration should be given to the effect of other environmental conditions, such as wind and humidity.

  • Hazards.  Includes a variety of physical conditions, such as proximity to moving mechanical parts, moving vehicles, electrical current or exposure to chemicals.

  • Atmospheric conditions.  One or more of the following conditions that affect the respiratory system or the skin:  fumes, odors, dust, mists, gases, or poor ventilation.

  • Oils. There is air and/or skin exposure to oils and other cutting fluids.

job.title: Journeyman Machinist
job.description:
Disclaimer: SLB completed the acquisition of ChampionX on July 16, 2025. If selected for this position, your employment will begin with ChampionX and will transition to SLB as part of the planned integration.

We are looking for a Coupling Robotic Cell Technician located in Tulsa, OK. This is your opportunity to join a global technology company, driving energy innovation for a balanced planet.

What’s In It For You:

  • Thrive in a company that values sustainability, drives a safety-focused culture, and empowers through continuous improvement

  • The support of an organization that believes it is vital to include and engage diverse people, perspectives, and ideas to achieve our best

  • Comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with company matching and more!

What you will do:

  • Sets up and operates various types of CNC, DNC and conventional milling machines and lathes that comprise a machine cell to manufacture parts to close tolerances.

  • Performs operations on individual or quantity production, tooling or experimental parts.

  • Selects mounts and aligns various machine attachments and standard or improvised tooling.

  • Sets and adjusts speed, feeds and depths of cut.

  • Edits programs on CNC equipment.

  • Conducts inspection to ensure parts or assemblies meet drawing specifications and tolerances.

  • Sharpens or grinds cutting tools.

  • Performs routine maintenance on the equipment.

  • Issues purchase orders to outside vendors, e.g., heat treat, plate, paint, etc.

  • Technicians will be involved in all phases of work in the cell from receiving, pulling raw material, machining, and assembling, inspecting, packaging through shipment of the finished product to the customer.

  • Maintains a clean and orderly machine and work area.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Completion of High School/Vocational Technical Training in machine tools with emphasis in shop math and basic computer skills or equivalent experience.

  • Five years of directly related experience.

Physical Demands: (if applicable)

job.title: Reservoir Engineer
job.description:
Disclaimer: SLB completed the acquisition of ChampionX on July 16, 2025. If selected for this position, your employment will begin with ChampionX and will transition to SLB as part of the planned integration.

We are searching for a Reservoir Engineer for our Technology team located in Sugar Land, Texas.  As a Reservoir Engineer, you will provide reservoir engineering support for assigned Chemically Enhanced Oil Recovery (CEOR) projects by coordinating activities with others within the team to collaboratively ensure targets are met. You will act as a liaison with internal and external customers and provide technical reports and presentations to diverse audiences. Through your work, you will perform and interpret relevant reservoir engineering analysis and draw appropriate conclusions.

What’s in it For You:

  • You will join a growing company offering competitive pay and benefits

  • Access to best-in-class resources, tools, and technology

  • Opportunity for a long term, advanced career path

  • A culture that values safety first, including training and personal protection

What You Will Do:

  • Provide reservoir engineering support that includes initial screening, data collection, engineering analysis, numerical simulation/prediction in both lab and field scales for CEOR projects (both R&D and customer-based projects)

  • Manage assigned projects and monitor progress to ensure targets are met, while liaising with internal and external customers.

  • Coordinate activities with the other groups involved (Technology, Marketing, Sales and other reservoir engineers).

  • Split your time between technical support projects and customer interaction.  It is expected that this position will spend minimum of 25% in customer-facing meetings.

  • Writing/presenting technical reports/publications (internally & externally)

  • Some advanced data analytics

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Petroleum, Chemical  or Mechanical Engineering

  • 6 years of relevant work experience in IOR (Improved Oil Recovery) / EOR (Enhanced Oil Recovery) techniques

  • Prior IOR/EOR experience in academic or industry setting

  • Understating of multi-phase flow through porous media, fluids property modelling  (phase behavior), routine and special core analysis

  • Experience in reservoir engineering including (not limited to) reservoir management, waterflooding performance evaluation/optimization, well testing,  interwell tracer data analysis 

  • Solid knowledge and experience in reservoir simulation including model construction, history matching, calibration and prediction

  • Proficient in Eclipse, CMG reservoir simulation software

  • Must be a creative thinker with the ability to build conceptual models to implement new ideas, processes and technologies

  • Proven ability to interact with a variety of contacts, both internal and external, including management and industry partners to identify and implement advanced reservoir engineering technologies.

  • Self-driven and ability to work under minimal supervision 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • PhD in Petroleum, Chemical  or Mechanical Engineering with 2 years of relevant work experience or MS with 4 years of relevant work experience

  • Advanced data analytics experience

  • Demonstrated organizational skills

  • Detail-orientated with excellent time management skills

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills

  • Demonstrated interpersonal skills to work effectively in a team environment and maintain a professional and positive attitude

  • Demonstrated ability to work and think independently

  • Project leadership/management experience

  • Open to new ideas and innovations

  • Ability to analyze and interpret complex data

Physical Demands:

  • Role is deemed safety-sensitive and may be subject to employer or customer drug testing

  • Must be able to lift up to 30 pounds

job.title: Account Manager
job.description:
We are looking for an Account Manager based in Perth, Australia.  The Account Manager will be primarily responsible for revenue and profit growth of PCT programs and services in targeted accounts within Australia.

You will be a self-starter, that has excellent time management skills and a desire to grow your accounts. In addition, you will be responsible for building long-term relationships throughout your customer base by understanding their key business drivers, executing system assurance programs, and selling new technologies.

If you are a passionate sales professional with a proven track record of success in technical sales, we invite you to apply. This is your opportunity to join a large growing company offering a competitive base salary, bonus structure and benefits.

What You Will Do:

  • Achieve annual sales, profitability, growth, and customer retention targets through the management and expansion of assigned customer accounts. 

  • Market and promote the full range of the Company's products and services to assigned customers and drive new business development and expansion opportunities. 

  • Develop, maintain, and execute strategic account plans aligned with customer objectives and business growth goals. 

  • Monitor market developments, customer initiatives, industry trends, and competitor activities, accurately assessing opportunities and threats and communicating relevant insights to management. 

  • Plans and executes the introduction of the Company's products and services to the assigned account 

  • Assesses and advises client on a wide range of commercial and technical proposals related to the Company's products and services 

  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships at operational, technical, procurement, and management levels, serving as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts. 

  • Lead periodic business reviews with customers, demonstrating operational performance, value delivered, improvement opportunities, and future growth initiatives. 

  • Monitor customer satisfaction and implement proactive retention plans to address customer risks and strengthen long-term partnerships. 

  • Provide technical expertise and recommendations related to Total Chemical Management, oil and gas production systems, flow assurance, integrity management, phase separation, water injection systems, chemical application facilities, and utility systems. 

  • Conduct field, laboratory, office, and offshore visits to evaluate treatment performance, troubleshoot operational challenges, and optimize chemical programs. 

  • Lead Operational Excellence initiatives within assigned accounts and apply the PROact Operational Assurance System to deliver sustainable customer value and performance improvements. 

  • Coordinate with Operations, Supply Chain, Technical Services, contractors, business partners, and customers to ensure effective execution of products and services. 

  • Develop operational and financial plans for assigned accounts and maintain accountability for approved budgets, forecasts, and business plans. 

  • Drive account profitability through treatment optimization, pricing discipline, operational efficiencies, and value-added solutions. 

  • Coordinate inventory planning, product forecasting, stock management, and product phase-in/phase-out activities with Operations and Supply Chain teams. 

  • Identify actual and potential non-conformances, implement corrective and preventive actions, and support continuous improvement initiatives in accordance with Company quality standards. 

  • Maintain accurate customer, operational, and commercial records, reports, forecasts, and account documentation. 

  • Provide technical guidance, coaching, and support to junior sales and field personnel and collaborate effectively across functions to achieve business objectives. 

  • Ensure compliance with all applicable regulatory requirements, customer standards, company policies, SHEQ requirements, and the Company's Code of Conduct.

  • Demonstrate visible leadership in safety by adhering to company HSE policies, participating in risk assessments and safety initiatives, promoting safe work practices, and supporting a culture of continuous safety improvement. 

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Minimum 8+ years of relevant oilfield or production chemical experience. 

  • Minimum 3-5 years of successful technical sales, account management, or business development experience preferred. 

  • Demonstrated success in managing strategic customer accounts and delivering revenue growth. 

  • Experience in contract management, commercial negotiations, and customer relationship management preferred. 

    Bachelor's Degree in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Science, or related technical discipline. 

  • Demonstrated competence in: 

  • Total Chemical Management 

  • Oil & Gas Production Systems 

  • Flow Assurance 

  • Integrity Management 

  • Phase Separation 

  • Water Injection Systems 

  • Chemical Application Facilities 

  • Utility Systems 

  • Production Chemical Applications 

  • Field Troubleshooting and Optimization 

  • Strong sales and business development capability. 
  • Proven ability to identify, develop, negotiate, and close business opportunities. 
  • Experience developing and executing strategic account plans. 
  • Strong commercial acumen with understanding of pricing, forecasting, budgeting, and profitability management. 
  • Ability to develop compelling value propositions and business cases. 
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite. 
  • Experience with CRM, forecasting, and account management systems preferred. 
  • Ability to travel extensively within Australia, including remote and offshore locations. 
  • Flexibility to work outside normal business hours as required to support customer operations. 
  • Valid driver's licence. 
  • Fluent in English.

job.description:

We are looking for a Field Service Technician with Prime Pump Solutions located in Odessa, TX. This is your opportunity to join a global technology company, driving energy innovation for a balanced planet.


What’s In It For You:


  • The ability to make an impact and shape your career with a company that is passionate about growth.

  • Thrive in a company that values sustainability, drives a safety-focused culture and empowers through continuous improvement.

What You Will Do:


  • Executes the commissioning and decommissioning of multiplex plunger pump skids and components at oil and gas well sites for use on Jet Pump artificial lift, Saltwater Disposal (SWD) Systems, and other facilities.
  • Perform repairs and troubleshoots multiplex plunger pumps and its auxiliary components for operation.  Including but not limited to; electric motor, variable speed drives (VSD/VFD), safety switches, flow meters, various valves, lubrication, and sump pumps.
  • Operate and service Horizontal Surface Pumps (HSP).
  • Assemble, operate, and troubleshoot Jet Lift systems and its components on surface and downhole used for artificial lift in the production of oil and gas wells.
  • Complete preventative maintenance on the above equipment at regular intervals.
  • Timely and accurately write up service tickets for the customers to review and be invoiced.
  • Develops good working relationships with customers through professional communication. 
  • Respond to customer calls and assist with technical questions.
  • Knows and complies with all safety policies and procedures.
  • Contributes to the department's continuous improvement culture.
  • Participate with on-call rotation for the facility, as required by the business.
  • Maintains a clean and well-organized work area and company truck.

Minimum Qualifications:


  • High school diploma or GED
  • 2 years of oilfield experience with servicing pump equipment.
  • Valid driver’s license in state of residence.
  • Must have an acceptable driving record.
  • Strong mechanical skills, able to perform mechanical field maintenance work to ensure optimal availability and reliability of artificial lift equipment at oil and gas wellsite locations.
  • Good oral and written communication skills, able to express thoughts clearly, both orally and in writing, using good grammar.
  • Good analytical and critical thinking skills. Able to identify and resolve problems in a timely manner.
  • Good computer skills, including Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Ability to troubleshoot customer issues and manage difficult or emotional customer situations; Responds promptly to customer needs; Solicits customer feedback to improve service; Responds to requests for service and assistance.
  • Ensures accountability by taking personal responsibility for the quality and timeliness of work and achieves results with little oversight.
  • Strong safety focus, able to identify and correct conditions that affect employee safety; upholding safety standards.

​

Physical Demands:

  • Must be able to lift and carry 25 lbs regularly and 50 lbs occasionally.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
  • The employee is regularly required to talk or hear.
  • The employee is frequently required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel and reach with hands and arms.
  • Employee is required to occasionally walk-in customer field locations which may include inclines, uneven surfaces, and a variety of weather conditions.
  • Employee must be able to regularly bend, stoop, crawl, lay down, twist and push.
  • Employee is required to wear appropriate personal protective equipment including but not limited to shoes/boots, hard hats, or respirators.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Basic understanding of multiplex plunger pumps commonly known as Triplex or Quintuplex pumps.
  • Experience with Jet Lift systems and it’s components.
  • Basic understanding of Horizontal Surface Pump system and its components
  • VFD and Automation experience

  • Working knowledge of multi-cylinder engines.

job.title: Staff Scientist
job.description:
Disclaimer: SLB completed the acquisition of ChampionX on July 16, 2025. If selected for this position, your employment will begin with ChampionX and will transition to SLB as part of the planned

integration.


We are looking for a Staff Scientist located in Sugar Land, TX. This is your opportunity to join a global technology company, driving energy innovation for a balanced planet.

 

The role will advance applied scientific research and product development for new products enabled by nanotechnology, focused on corrosion control and other production chemistry domains. The successful candidate will leverage deep expertise in formulation, corrosion testing, structure-property relationships and field applications to design, formulate, and scale differentiated production chemistry solutions that address complex customer challenges and deliver high-impact innovation.

 

What You Will Do:

  • Adopt, maintain, and promote safety standards while identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Conduct applied scientific research to advance technical knowledge and solve complex production challenges related to corrosion control and other production chemistry domains.
  • Apply fundamental knowledge of chemistry and interfacial science to formulate new products that solve industry needs.
  • Design formulations, laboratory screening and performance evaluation strategies that connect formulation variables to corrosion control and field applicability.
  • Lead and execute transformational innovation projects with potential global reach and high business impact.
  • Conduct standardized testing protocols to evaluate product performance, analyze research data, and prepare detailed reports and presentations.
  • Own subject matter expertise for self-initiated research and serve as a technical resource, teacher, and mentor for others.
  • Leverage external technology and collaborations with industry or academia during the innovation process.
  • Steward technical documentation and intellectual property, while monitoring the competitive landscape for disruptive technologies.
  • Work directly with business counterparts and customers to identify needs, translate those needs into technical solutions, and support new technology adoption.
  • Drive continuous improvement of the business to responsibly deliver energy and contribute to a safety-focused, inclusive, and sustainable culture.
  • Leadership, Culture, and Business Impact:
  • Lead innovation with high business impact by applying strategic understanding of global markets, adjacencies, customer needs, and technical gaps to deliver breakthrough solutions.
  • Embody operating principles that reinforce safety, continuous improvement, accountability, collaboration, and inclusive leadership.
  • Build a broad sphere of influence as a safety leader, corporate citizen, mentor, and technical contributor.
  • Grow subject matter expertise through independent learning and by staying current with advances in science and technology.
  • Address personal development opportunities through self-awareness, feedback, mentoring, and engagement with senior leadership.

Physical Demands:

  • This role is deemed safety-sensitive and may be subject to employer or customer drug testing. 

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, or related technical field. PhD with 6+ years of relevant work experience; MS with 8+ years; or BS with 10+ years.
  • Experience with corrosion control chemistry and advanced characterization techniques.
  • Strong background in interfacial science, structure property relationships, and formulation science. Nanotechnology experience is an advantage
  • Proven capability developing innovative solutions, including product formulation and development.
  • Ability to work with business counterparts to support customers and enable new technology adoption.
  • Proven track record in mentoring, guiding, and coaching less experienced employees, influencing without authority.
  • Ability to analyze and interpret incomplete information and make sound technical recommendations.
  • Strong record of technical documentation, including reports, presentations, and intellectual property contributions.

 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Ability to connect and interact with business and marketing collaborations to clearly identify needs and translate those needs into solutions.
  • Experience transitioning product development from laboratory scale to pilot and production scale.
  • Experience with formal Design of Experiments and/or data analytics.
  • Detail-oriented work style with excellent time management skills.
  • Excellent written, oral, and visual communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively at all levels of the organization and with external stakeholders.
  • Recognition as a technical expert, mentor, industry contributor, or trusted technical advisor.

job.description:
We are looking for a Senior Account Manager based in Perth, Australia.  The Senior Account Manager will be primarily responsible for revenue and profit growth of PCT programs and services in targeted accounts within Australia. There is a strong emphasis on coaching and leading a group of sales professionals, helping them to develop strong account leadership skills and to convert strategic competitive accounts. The role is a primary resource to the Area Manager, assisting with execution of corporate initiatives, hiring and training of new Sales Representatives.


If you are a passionate sales professional with a proven track record of success in technical sales, we invite you to apply. This is your opportunity to join a large growing company offering a competitive base salary, bonus structure and benefits.


What You Will Do:

  • Responsible for forecasting revenues and profitability for area customers and accountable for managing P&L for area.
  • Counsels and develops sales representatives; Coaches moderate-sized customers.
  • Work closely with team on strategic current and prospective customers to help define key business needs, and to recommend continuous improvement and innovation plans that will maintain and grow sales in your assigned area.
  • Develop strong relationships with key stakeholders in the current and prospective customers in your area, including site or facility executives.
  • Work closely with team on generating and executing sales plans and strategies to close new opportunities in existing customer base, and in major, competitively held accounts, to meet defined area profit increase goals.
  • Provide business and technical support to Reps in their customer accounts; identifying and resolving customer complaints, and escalating as required.
  • Work closely with team on actively selling and supporting the Company's innovations and technology in their assigned customers to promote long-term business relationships with the Company.
  • Assist with the planning and execution of successful customer and prospect Seminars, demonstrating the Company's market leadership within the local geography
  • Development and maintenance of an effective working relationship with Key Customers promoting the desired image of the Company and ensuring Customer satisfaction.
  • Proactive identification and resolution of issues reported by field chemists or customer, work to create and present solutions as appropriate, balancing the Company's needs and managing customer expectations. Prepare and deliver both technical and commercial presentations.
  • Leadership in the preparation and delivery of business review meetings for area of responsibility, both internally and externally
  • Active collaboration and knowledge sharing with other personnel within the Company by exchanging information, potential new business opportunities, chemical applications and best practices, by regularly leveraging on available knowledge sharing platforms, such as CORE
  • Exhibit leadership in the theory and application of the PROact customer management model. This includes, not only training and coaching, but also exhibiting proficiency in its application to sales processes and clearly communicating and documenting value provided to customers
  • Participate in trials, audits and field support activities as required, ensuring to adhere to internal and external safe work practices, policies and procedures, actively taking part in safety initiatives
  • Proficient in most types of field work, including sampling and testing knowledge, willing and able to transfer that expertise to more Junior representatives through active training and coaching
  • Work to resolve any conflicts in a productive and collaborative manner
  • Assist internal functional teams by providing, as necessary, information regarding customer trends, issues and requests related to products / applications / systems

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering or Chemistry.
  • 10+ years of successful technical sales and sales management experience.
  • Demonstrate competence in Total Chemical Management, oil & gas production systems, Phase Separation, Flow assurance, integrity management, water injection, chemical application facilities and utility systems.
  • High computer application literacy (including Microsoft Office Suite, and ability to learn internal business systems)
  • Prior experience that required excellent communication skills
  • Prior experience that required excellent organizational skills
  • Prior experience that demonstrates a strong work ethic and ability to multi-task
  • History of working in a field that required autonomy and self-motivation
  • Sales history of calling on multi-level plant or facilities management and developing executive-level relationships.
  • Candidate must reside in Perth and be prepared to travel customer operating site locations in Central Australia and Queensland where required
  • Ensuring full compliance with all applicable regulatory and corporate standards.
  • Maintain strict adherence to the Code of Conduct policy.
  • Seek to further the culture within the Company, which embodies our purpose “Improving Lives”, our business “Unlocking Energy” and our operating principles “Customer Advocates”, “People Oriented”, “Technology with Impact” and “Driven to Improve”.

job.title: Procure to Pay Accelerator
job.description:
Disclaimer: SLB completed the acquisition of ChampionX on July 16, 2025. If selected for this position, your employment will begin with ChampionX and will transition to SLB as part of the planned integration.


We are looking for a Procurement Operations Specialist located in Dubai, UAE. This is your opportunity to join a global technology company, driving energy innovation for a balanced planet.


This role is expected to partner closely with our global and regional procurement teams, Global Finance Shared Service Center, department buyers for source to pay activities including but not limited to vendor onboarding, material pricing, purchase requisition to purchase order conversion, manage invoice disputes, and serves as a subject matter expert in either processes, systems or compliance. This role will also be actively engaged in the testing and execution of the future Source to Pay process environment, collaborate with suppliers to create punch out or hosted catalogs, convert PR to PO for materials and services not covered by catalogs, train end users on the current and future procurement processes.


What’s in it For You:

  • The ability to make an impact and shape your career with a company that is passionate about growth
  • The support of an organization that believes it is vital to include and engage diverse people, perspectives, and ideas to achieve our best.
  • Thrive in a company that values sustainability, drives a safety-focused culture and has been recognized as one of the most ethical companies in the world.
  • Access to Employee Resource Groups (ERG’s). These grassroots, employee-led groups are open to anyone in the organization and allow employees to come together to explore common interests and foster a diverse and inclusive workplace within the organization.
  • Access to multiple knowledge sharing platforms to enhance collaboration and engagement.

What You Will Do:

  • Sets up and maintains outline agreements in SAP globally in line with the requirements of sourcing team. 
  • Reviews blocked invoices to ensure timely resolution for the same. 
  • Prepares training documents for other functions to review the existing procedures and processes and train/ guide them when necessary.
  • Applies appropriate data cleansing tools to review and audit Procurement data; research potential duplicate records; maintain the vendor master data as per the standards. 
  • Utilizes the appropriate application tools and available resources to manage workload and complete assigned duties ensuring commitments are delivered on time.
  • Assists in resolution of supplier issues. Work with all functions in resolution of billing discrepancies, shipment conditions accuracy etc.
  • Completes and monitors reports like compliance monitoring, invoice dispute resolutions, supplier management, PR PO cycle time etc. 
  • Develop and execute action plans, take appropriate action to correct errors and implement changes to stop errors from occurring. 
  • Participate in special projects as directed including automation and process improvements.
  • Document procurement workflows and assist in the standardization of processes. 
  • Identify systemic issues and recommend process improvements; integrate updates of procurement requirements into department processes. 
  • Assist the stakeholders in the procure to pay process, including PR/PO creation, issue resolutions and any other issues arising in the process. 

S4 HANA Project


  • Accountable and responsible for rolling out the future SAP based solution (Global Template) for the procure to Pay (P2P) solution including requirements gathering, analysis/ design workshops, define solution design that meets business goals. development, data collection/ conversion/ governance, UAT coordination and execution, cutover activities and hyper care.
  • Assist in the configuration, testing, and deployment of procurement functionalities including Purchase Requisition, Purchase Order, Supplier Management, and Invoice Processing.
  • Participate in the development of solution design documents, functional design documents, test plans and test scripts.
  • Provide end-user training, documentation, and ongoing support to ensure effective system adoption.
  • Leads, champions, execute end to end testing for procure to pay functionalities.
  • Monitor and report on rollout progress, risks, and mitigation strategies.
  • Support data migration, validation, and cleansing activities related to procurement master data.
  • Ensure compliance with internal controls, procurement policies, and regulatory requirements.

Key Behaviors and Competencies:

  • Ability to work collaboratively across multi-functional teams in global locations.

job.title: Instrument Technician
job.description:
Disclaimer: SLB completed the acquisition of ChampionX on July 16, 2025. If selected for this position, your employment will begin with ChampionX and will transition to SLB as part of the planned integration.

We are looking for a Instrument Technician located in Fawley, Southampton. This is your opportunity to join a global technology company, driving energy innovation for a balanced planet.

 

What’s in it For You:

The ability to make an impact and shape your career with a company that is passionate about growth.

The support of an organisation that believes it is vital to include and engage diverse people, perspectives, and ideas to achieve our best.

Thrive in a company that values sustainability, drives a safety-focused culture and empowers its employees through continuous improvement.

 

What You Will Do:

  • Carry out instrument planned, preventive and breakdown maintenance.
  • Carry out calibration of instruments to schedule and maintain calibration records and test equipment.
  • Fault-find on 4–20 mA/HART loops, pneumatic systems and control system I/O.
  • Carry out proof testing of safety instrumented functions and alarm testing to schedule.
  • Carry out inspection and maintenance of hazardous area (Ex) equipment in line with DSEAR and site requirements.
  • Carry out project installation (CAPEX) and commissioning, including loop checks, review and mark up of drawings.
  • Complete production-critical repairs and all critical inspections in a safe and timely manner to maximise availability of plant and avoid overdue inspection activities.
  • Assist and coordinate contractors and service personnel in maintaining instrument, electrical and other plant equipment.
  • Record all work accurately in the CMMS, including feedback to improve maintenance routines and asset data.
  • Identify critical spares and raise requisitions for parts, tools and test equipment.
  • Execute work in a safe manner in accordance with safe working practices, site standards, and site safety systems such as Permit to Work, Task Risk Assessments and Maintenance Procedures.
  • Liaise with instrument, electrical and other specialist engineers.
  • Take part in root cause investigations, reliability improvements, department audits and site safety initiatives.

 

 

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Recognised apprenticeship or company traineeship scheme.
  • Appropriate technical qualification in instrumentation, electrical or a related discipline, e.g. NVQ Level 3, City and Guilds, ONC, HNC.
  • Experience maintaining instrumentation, electrical or control systems in an industrial environment.
  • Training and approval to work on hazardous area equipment, e.g. CompEx Ex01–Ex04, or willingness to obtain.

Physical Demands:

  • This role requires working in a chemical manufacturing plant.

 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 5 years’ experience in refinery, chemical or allied industry working on instrumented systems.
  • Experience of calibration, loop checking and PLC/DCS fault-finding.
  • Awareness of functional safety (IEC 61511) and proof testing.
  • 18th Edition BS 7671.
  • Immigration sponsorship not offered for this role

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or GED

  • 4 years of experience
